description:
FleetCommander is a robust, customizable Fleet Management Information System (FMIS). 
The platform offers seamless vehicle reservation capabilities, along with tools to analyze and forecast fleet demand and capacity. It also streamlines data collection for odometer readings, driver credentials, check-in and check-out activity, and more. With intuitive reporting and analytics features, FleetCommander provides the visibility and control needed to optimize fleet utilization, enhance compliance, and support data-driven decision-making.

description: The information system manages the use of and processes the transactions/ sessions for electric vehicle charging for stations sold to US federal and associated customers. The cloud information system communicates with charging stations located at client sites, facilitating interactions between public and government users and the charging infrastructure, establishes/ initiates charging sessions, and accepts payments and/or account authorization for station use. The system stores customer/ organizational information to provide services to the end user/ customer/ organization. The system identifies and validates authorized users of the charging infrastructure and updates user/ organizational account with usage statistics.
